name: Democracy
summary: Simultaneous trick-taking where a flipped pool card sets trump and points per suit are contested to win tribes.
rules_text: Remove 2s from 52-card deck leaving 48 cards. For 4 players add 2 jokers, for 6 add 1 joker. Rank high to low: 5-4-3-A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6. Points: 5=5, 4=4, 3/A=3, K/Q/J=2, 10/9/8/7=1, 6=0. Joker=0. Each suit totals 25. Deal cards in two days: half the deck each day plus a face-down voting pool of equal size to hand size. Each trick dealer flips one pool card for trump. Each player chooses one hand card face down, then all reveal together. If any trump is played highest trump wins, except 6 of trump beats 5 of trump if both present. If no trump highest rank wins any suit. Tied high with no trump: each takes own card, voting card discarded. Joker cannot be trump; loses to any trump, ties/wins otherwise vs 5s. Winner captures played cards plus voting card. After both days count points per suit; majority 13+ points scores one tribe. First to agreed total tribes wins match.
rating_reason: Simultaneous reveal trick-taking like GOPS, strategic
